node.title: Re^5: Code Works But Not Sure How
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I wasn't sure how to access it. I was look at it strictly as {$menu_items = []}.

Have a look at [doc://perlreftut] (and for details, [doc://perlref]): An array reference can always be dereferenced with @{...}, so in this case foreach my $item ( @{ $items->{menu_items} } ).
